title: SCU study of UFOs at nuclear sites

tellings.quote: SEU did a study on this. UFOs monitoring nuclear sites.

plain: UFOs were watching American nuclear sites, starting in the 1940s, and the physicist Kevin Knuth tells Michels that a study by the SCU, the Scientific Coalition for UAP Studies (a group of researchers who study unexplained sightings), looked into this. He mentions the study in passing and does not go into its findings. If true, it would mean whatever is behind the sightings takes a particular interest in nuclear weapons.
